career_ladder.note: Junior Assistant cum Computer Assistant is an entry-level ministerial appointment in the Andhra Pradesh Revenue Subordinate Service, organized into District Cadres. Promotion requires passing departmental tests (Revenue Tests Part I & II and Accounts Test for Subordinate Officers Part I) to advance to supervisory and gazetted revenue administrative posts.

exam_scheme.note: Examination scheme consists of a Screening Test (OMR-based offline, held when applicants exceed 200 times vacancies), a Main Examination (Computer Based Test), followed by a qualifying Computer Proficiency Test (CPT) for shortlisted candidates in a 1:2 ratio. Negative marking of 1/3rd (0.33) mark applies to each wrong answer in Screening and Mains as per G.O.Ms.No.235 Finance dated 06.12.2016.

financial_package.note: Compensated under Andhra Pradesh Revised Pay Scales (RPS) 2022 (11th PRC, implemented via G.O.Ms.No.1 Finance Department dated 17.01.2022). Entry scale for Junior Assistant is Scale 7 (₹25,220 - ₹80,910) replacing the pre-revised 2015 scale of ₹16,400 - ₹49,870 cited in Notification No. 23/2021.
financial_package.pay_source_label: APPSC Notification No. 23/2021 read with G.O.Ms.No.1 Finance (PC-TA) Dept dt 17.01.2022 (AP RPS 2022 Master Scale)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on AP PRC 2022 Scale 7 entry basic pay of ₹25,220 at standardized 58% DA plus HRA (8% to 16% depending on district/mandal category) and fixed medical allowance; in-hand estimate deducts 10% CPS/NPS, Professional Tax (₹200), and APGLI/GIS.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per AP PRC 2022 classification (8% to 16%)
Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) / Andhra Pradesh Guaranteed Pension Scheme (APGPS)
Andhra Pradesh Employees Health Scheme (EHS) cashless medical coverage
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) within Andhra Pradesh and across India as per AP state rules
Earned leave and half-pay leave surrender encashment benefits
